scope: covers exactly systems_audited, measured at generated_utc; the final completeness audit is --system all

references.units: model energy units (beta = 16); F' per unit x
references.gauge: F_ref and F_ref_em centred on the eval window [-1.5, 1.5] (151 grid nodes); errors via eqb_metrics.GatewayFamilyScorer
references.secondary_definition: per-dynamics frozen-x Euler-Maruyama-consistent mean force at the cell's h and lambda: alpha family 4Hx(x^2-1) + ((1-alpha)/beta) w'/w + (alpha/beta)(w'/w) / (1 - lam w^(2 alpha) h/2) (the EM y-update y <- (1 - lam w^(2 alpha) h) y + sqrt(2 lam h/beta) z has stationary variance 1/(beta w^(2 alpha) (1 - lam w^(2 alpha) h/2))); shifted fibre: F*'(x) exactly (the frozen-x EM chain of y has mean m(x) exactly)

scorer.floor_definition: errors of the scorer fed the exact bin-averaged reference mean force (Gamma_j = <F'_ref>_j on the Gauss-Legendre sub-grid, infinite counts); for e_Fp / e_Fp_em it is a HARD lower bound: e_Fp^2 = e_Fp_stat^2 + floor^2 for every Gamma (within-bin variation of F'_ref, steep at the gate); e_F at Gamma = <F'_ref> is ~0
scorer.scorer: scripts/analyze_gateway_replica_ladder.py Scorer (analytic primary, identical for every variant and lambda); secondary = eqb_family.family_mean_force (per-dynamics EM-consistent)
scorer.em_bias_definition: em_floor_F_rms: RMS of F_ref_em - F_ref on the eval window (centred); em_bias_Fp_bin_rms: RMS over the eval bins of <F'_em>_j - <F'_ref>_j, F'_em = this dynamics' frozen-x EM-consistent mean force (NOT the e_F' floor)
scorer.secondary_definition: per-dynamics frozen-x Euler-Maruyama-consistent mean force at the cell's h and lambda: alpha family 4Hx(x^2-1) + ((1-alpha)/beta) w'/w + (alpha/beta)(w'/w) / (1 - lam w^(2 alpha) h/2) (the EM y-update y <- (1 - lam w^(2 alpha) h) y + sqrt(2 lam h/beta) z has stationary variance 1/(beta w^(2 alpha) (1 - lam w^(2 alpha) h/2))); shifted fibre: F*'(x) exactly (the frozen-x EM chain of y has mean m(x) exactly)
